k_reset_q: All progress and records will be erased. This cannot be undone.
title: Lanternfall
delete_q: Delete file {0}? This cannot be undone.
help_move: Run with the left stick, the D-pad or the arrow keys
help_jump: Jump; hold it to jump higher
help_attack: Swing the lantern; jump on enemies to stomp them
help_dash: Dash through the air (learned in the Crystal Caverns)
help_shrine: Light shrines to save your progress and heal
help_shards: Every level hides three star shards
help_touch: Touch: stick on the left, jump, swing and dash buttons on the right
tip_jump: {0} jumps; hold it to jump higher
tip_stomp: Jump on most enemies to stomp them, but not on spiky ones
tip_shrine: Shrines save your progress; you return here if you fall
tip_shards: Three star shards hide in every level
tip_double: Press {0} again in the air to jump twice
tip_dash: {0} dashes forward, even in the air
tip_wall: Hold towards a wall to slide, then press {0} to leap off it
end1: The Storm Owl falls silent and the clouds part.
end2: The last lantern is home, and the valley wakes in its light.
